project_type: Multi-stack boilerplates mono-repository with 52 standalone starters
language: TypeScript (Next.js App Router for these 4 starters)
build_system: pnpm 10.x with exact-pinned deps, each starter is standalone
test_framework: Vitest + fast-check property tests + Testing Library; tests in tests/{unit,integration,property,smoke}
build_command: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run build (per starter)
test_command: pnpm run test (vitest run, per starter)
verification_instructions: For each starter: cd into folder, pnpm install, pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm test, pnpm build. All must pass with fake/placeholder env values.
setup_instructions: Node 22 LTS + pnpm 10.x. Each starter runs independently. No root dependencies needed for starter code.
environment_constraints: Internet available. Each starter must work with placeholder env values (fake adapters activate). No real provider credentials needed for validation.
contribution_requirements: Exact-pinned dependencies. Provider adapters behind local interfaces with fake defaults. Property-based tests (fast-check). Deny-by-default auth. Sanitized errors. Typed config boundary. Each starter gets its own branch.
key_patterns: domain/ has entities.ts and policies.ts; lib/server/ has config.ts, errors.ts, auth.ts, providers.ts, billing.ts, billing-fake.ts, mail.ts, mail-fake.ts; app/ has page.tsx, auth/, dashboard/, api/webhooks/; tests/ has unit/, integration/, property/, smoke/; migrations in prisma/ or supabase/migrations/; starter.json at root; .env.example with classified sections
directory_structure: Root has catalog/, scripts/, .kiro/specs/, and each starter as a top-level folder. Each Web SaaS starter follows: app/ (pages+api), domain/ (entities+policies), lib/server/ (adapters+config), tests/ (unit/integration/property/smoke), migrations, starter.json, .env.example, README.md
